name: Starter App
tagline: A neutral starting point. Replace this brand with your app's own before designing screens.

personality.name: Clear
personality.description: Says one thing at a time and leaves room around it.

personality.name: Calm
personality.description: Quiet surfaces and steady motion; nothing shouts for attention.

personality.name: Capable
personality.description: Gets out of the way so the work stays in focus.

voice.summary: Plain and direct. Lead with what happened or what to do next, in as few words as it takes.
do: Add a payment method to continue.
dont: Your request could not be processed at this time.

marks.name: Mark
marks.description: Placeholder symbol: a rounded tile with a round counter. Replace it with the app mark.

clearSpace.note: A quarter of the mark's height on every side.

minimumSize.note: Below 16 px the counter fills in.

marks.name: Wordmark
marks.description: Placeholder wordmark set in Inter and outlined to paths. Replace it with the app name.

clearSpace.note: Half the wordmark's height on every side.

minimumSize.note: Below 64 px wide, use the mark.

do: Use an approved variant on its listed background.
Keep the clear space free of text and other marks.
Use the mark alone below the wordmark's minimum size.
dont: Stretch, rotate, or add effects to a mark.
Recolor a mark outside its approved variants.
Retype the wordmark in a font.
